current_baseline.sky_ratio_note: sky_ratio=1.0 makes is_sky always true => th_ground never gates anything (it becomes a dead parameter) AND the salvage tier / hover exemption / sky-aware rigid pruning cover the WHOLE frame.  It is not merely 'one uniform threshold'.  th_deep=0.0 is dead in all three versions (the code only enables the deep band when th_deep > 0).
